pr_title: drivers: led: pca9633: add support for multiple devices
pr_body:
PCA9633 only supports one device.
Rewrite of the driver to support multiple devices.
Fixes #40076
pr_comments: @daniel-nicolai-hansten Please rework the commit as per: https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/contribute/#commit-guidelines
Would it be possible to backport this to zephyr 2.7?

issue_context.title: Driver led pca9633 does only use first device in devicetree
